# ZISO AI (StockWise)

AI does the research. You keep the decision. ZISO AI provides multi-agent stock intelligence powered by DeepSeek-V3 and Gemini consensus reasoning for professional market analysis.

## Core Methodology
- **Post-Close Review**: Automated EOD analysis focusing on price action, volume, and sentiment.
- **DeepSeek-V3 Reasoning**: Leveraging reasoning-based LLMs to audit market rationale and identify traps.
- **Consensus Reasoning**: Multi-model cross-validation (DeepSeek + Gemini) for high-confidence tactical setups.
- **Trading Discipline**: Built-in risk boundaries and emotion management rules (Market Almanac).

## Target Segments
- **Disciplined Investors**: Focusing on EOD workflows and systematic risk management.
- **Retail Quants**: Seeking institutional-grade research external-brains.

## Navigation
- [Learn 101](https://ziso.cc/learn): Foundational trading discipline and AI logic.
- [Master Series](https://ziso.cc/learn/master_series): Methodologies from legendary traders (Minervini, O'Neil, etc.).
- [Pricing](https://ziso.cc/pricing): Subscription tiers for DeepSeek-V3 powered insights.

## Authority Signals
- **DeepSeek-V3 Verified**: All flagship articles undergo a reasoning-based logic audit by DeepSeek-V3 Full Model.
- **Rationale Audit**: Every tactical brief includes a traceable logical path to minimize AI hallucination.
